environment.pacing: GT4_PACING unset or paced (default): paced clock. GT4_PACING=audio: blocking WinMM clock as in slice152. The launcher refuses other values and records both names in result.json (pacing_environment).

classification: TASK-060/061/062 on the stable gt4-gs 1.0.0 (GS stream protocol 1.2). Game side (slice199 plus): the cursor hides over the picture after 3 s without movement (GT4_CURSOR_AUTOHIDE, default on; native/cursor_autohide.*) and the policy goes to gt4-gs as CONTROL cursor; when gt4-gs draws the performance overlay (READY kReadyFlagOsdStats) the game sends OSD_STATS every 0.5 s (EE thread CPU, VU1 worker busy, GS stream write, readback, back-pressure and VU1 worker waits, critical path; perf_probe cumulative category times). gt4-gs 1.0.0: cursor auto-hide on the child window, "Compiling shaders..." notice (real compiles only), performance overlay (off by default), settings outside the allow-list ignored with a warning. With the overlay off the GS stream is unchanged.
preserved_inputs: Same runtime capsule (slice191-gs-stream-runtime), port (slice191-gs-stream-port), shaders (slice153-pacing-shaders), EE library, VU1 and VU0 tables as slice199; changed: native/window.cpp, native/cursor_autohide.*, native/gs_stream/gs_stream_client.* and gs_stream_protocol.h (1.2), native/perf_probe.* (cumulative category times), native/mtvu_runtime.* and native/mtvu_bridge.cpp (VU1 worker busy time), tools/gs_live_check; the pinned gt4-gs package (1.0.0).
limits: Unsynchronized readbacks answer from the PCSX2 GS local memory copy: GPU-drawn pixels are stale (zeros in the gs_live_check sprite test), so the night-race lens flare may change; accurate is the default.
Deferred swap chain acquire and detached input queues are checked only with hidden windows; the owner checks the visible window (fullscreen, Alt+Tab, minimize).
Interlaced races (480i held) and the 1080i/PAL modes are not checked; only the 480i menus capture (slice191 stream) was replayed headless.
Save states are refused in pcsx2 mode.
The owner night-race numbers (59.97 FPS, 53 late frames) were measured on slice198 with gt4-gs 0.3.2; slice199 on gt4-gs 0.4.0 needs the owner's night race and F8 A/B (GT4_MTVU_PRIV_ASYNC 1 vs 0).
GT4_MTVU_PRIV_ASYNC is proven equivalent (identical stream bytes, identical frames) on the recorded headless schedules only; race scenes are checked by the owner F8 A/B.

The cursor auto-hide, the "Compiling shaders" notice and the overlay are checked with a short visible fixture window and hidden-window replays only; the owner checks them in the game (fullscreen and windowed).
GPU usage comes from the Windows "GPU Engine" performance counters (PDH) of the two processes; other GPU vendors and drivers are not checked.

gs_package.source: the published stable release gt4gs-v1.0.0 (fork branch gt4gs/osd), built on the owner PC with gt4gs/release-local.ps1 -Release (GT4GS_ONLY=ON, deps of private/slice193-gt4gs-deps; gt4gs/check-nojit.ps1 passed on the package); the zip was downloaded back from the release, checked against its SHA256SUMS and extracted: the pinned package is the published one
